name: case-study-page
title: Case study page
description: The site's case study: a centered head (breadcrumb, headline, kind and read time), the facts with the products it uses, the lead picture, the opening line over three figures, a pull quote, the sections with a second quote, and the pager to the other studies, with ASCII crops in the margins from 1024.
use_for: A customer story or case study page; `study` takes the story (lib/pages/case-studies.ts shows the fields), `content.studies` the list the pager walks.
never: Real customers, people, quotes or logos unless you may show them: the examples are Acme
Another brand's photo as the lead picture without permission: the placeholder stands in
Figures that are not true for the story: they read as facts
source: Site app/resources/case-studies/[slug]/page.tsx and pages/CaseStudies (CaseStudyArticle.tsx, CaseStudyPage.module.css): head 80/48px (160/64 from 1024), 24px gaps (32 from 1024), the title at most 880px; the 640px measure; facts 2 then 4 columns, 24/20 gaps, 48px under (64 from 768), underlined links in --line-strong; the cover 16:9 (4:5 under 768) with --radius-m; the lead .t-lead 64px down, figures 48px further over a hairline, h4 values; body 64/96px, the pull quote 32px in on --surface, sections 96px apart with h4 titles (h2 from 1024), paragraphs 24px apart in --text-2, the aside 40px down with a --line-strong rule; the pager 40px tall padding between hairlines; drifts from 1024 beside each band
body:
`sections` lists the sections to show, in order (`head`, `facts`, `cover`, `lead`, `body`, `more`, `close`); a key
left out is not shown. All but the close stay inside the article, where the first of them falls. The study's `cover`
is an image slot; without `src` the placeholder carries `data-ds-placeholder`. `menus` passes the header menus (the
live card's `picture`, the use cases' `shots`).

import { html, nothing, svg } from 'lit' import { DsElement, define, HostLayoutController } from '@/elements/lib/element' import { asciiDriftStyle, type AsciiDriftCrop, type AsciiDriftFrom } from '@/lib/ascii-drift' import { caseStudies, caseStudyContent, caseStudyMinutes, caseStudyNeighbors, type CaseStudy, type CaseStudyContent, caseStudyPageSections, type CaseStudyPageSection } from '@/lib/pages/case-studies' import '@/elements/components/ui/badge' import '@/elements/components/site/creative-card' import '@/elements/components/site/site-header' import '@/elements/components/site/page-close' import '@/elements/components/blocks/site-footer' import '@/elements/components/visuals/ascii-trail' import styles from 'virtual:tw' import { pageSections, groupSections, imageFit } from '@/lib/image' import { styleMap } from 'lit/directives/style-map.js' import { headerMenus, type HeaderMenus } from '@/lib/site-header' // CaseStudyPage.tsx as : the header, the centered head (breadcrumb, headline, kind and read // time), the facts, the lead picture, the opening line and figures, the pull quote, the sections and the pager, the // closing section and the footer; ASCII crops in the margins from 1024. `study` (JSON) picks the study, `content` // (JSON) the rest (lib/pages/case-studies.ts; its studies set the pager). Links change color; nothing moves. const ARTICLE: readonly CaseStudyPageSection[] = ['head', 'facts', 'cover', 'lead', 'body', 'more'] const CONTAINER = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-[calc(var(--ds-layout-content)+2*var(--ds-layout-gutter))] px-(--ds-layout-gutter)' const MEASURE = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-[calc(var(--ds-layout-measure)+2*var(--ds-layout-gutter))] px-(--ds-layout-gutter)' const HEAD_SIDE = 'w-[calc((100%-880px)/2-64px)]' const BODY_SIDE = 'w-[calc((100%-var(--ds-layout-measure))/2-64px)]' const LABEL = 'type-ui text-fg-muted transition-[color] duration-160 ease-out group-hover:text-fg group-focus-visible:text-fg' const drift = (crop: AsciiDriftCrop, from: AsciiDriftFrom, place: string, hero = false) => html`` const arrow = (back = false) => html`` /** * @summary A case study article. */ export class CaseStudyPage extends DsElement { static styles = [DsElement.styles, styles] protected readonly layout = new HostLayoutController(this, () => this.renderRoot.querySelector('[data-ds="case-study-page"]')) static properties = { study: { type: Object }, content: { type: Object }, menus: { type: Object }, sections: { type: Array } } /** The study (the first of lib/pages/case-studies.ts by default). */ study: CaseStudy = caseStudies[0] /** The copy and the studies for the pager. */ content: CaseStudyContent = caseStudyContent /** The header menus' content, pictures included (the live card's `picture`, the use cases' `shots`); Acme by default. */ menus?: HeaderMenus /** The sections to show, in order (a list of names); all of them in the page order by default. */ sections?: CaseStudyPageSection[] render() { const c = this.content ?? caseStudyContent const s = this.study ?? caseStudies[0] const { previous, next } = caseStudyNeighbors(c.studies, s.slug) const id = `${s.slug}-heading` const cover = s.cover?.src ? html`` : html`
` const pager = next ? html`
${previous ? html`${arrow(true)}${c.labels.previous}${previous.company}` : html``}${c.labels.next}${arrow()}${next.company}
` : nothing const parts: Record = { head: html`
${drift('column', 'left', `${HEAD_SIDE} top-[8%] left-0 h-[84%]`, true)}${drift('scatter', 'right', `${HEAD_SIDE} top-0 right-0 h-[72%]`, true)}
${c.labels.all.label}/${s.company}

${s.headline}

${s.kind}${c.labels.read(caseStudyMinutes(s))}

`, facts: html`
${drift('mass', 'right', `${BODY_SIDE} -top-8 right-0 h-40`)}
${s.facts.map((f) => html`
${f.label}
${f.value}
`)}
${c.labels.uses}
${s.uses.map((u, i) => html`${u.label}${i < s.uses.length - 1 ? ', ' : nothing}`)}
`, cover: html`
${cover}
`, lead: html`
${drift('cluster', 'left', `${BODY_SIDE} top-0 left-0 h-full`)}

${s.lead}

    ${s.figures.map((f) => html`
  • ${f.value}${f.label}
    • `)}
`, body: html`
${drift('scatter', 'right', `${BODY_SIDE} top-[8%] right-0 h-[28%]`)}${drift('column', 'left', `${BODY_SIDE} top-[52%] left-0 h-[30%]`)}

“${s.quote.text}”

${s.quote.role ? `${s.quote.name}, ${s.quote.role}` : s.quote.name}
${s.sections.map((section, i) => html`

${section.title}

${section.paragraphs.map((p) => html`

${p}

`)}${i === 1 && s.aside ? html`

“${s.aside.text}”

${s.aside.name}
` : nothing}
`)}
`, more: html`${pager}`, close: html``, } return html`
${groupSections(pageSections(caseStudyPageSections, this.sections), ARTICLE).map((k) => (Array.isArray(k) ? html`
${k.map((a) => parts[a])}
` : parts[k]))}
` } } define('case-study-page', CaseStudyPage)
